name: vx3-prep-first-hop-slice-a-d1-d4-20270415-20270421
qualityPolicyNotes: Vx-3 preparatory capability slice A (serial 47): introduce the Phase B classifier-preferred first hop inside client_flow.c. The controlled switch temporarily reuses the existing --enable-preclass-actions flag (preclass_action_enable, default off) as a transitional gate for this slice only; a dedicated --enable-preclass-first-hop option is planned for the follow-up slice (49/50) that completes cross-platform option parsing, after which this gate switches to the dedicated flag. --disable-address-preclass remains the full rollback. allocated/legacy classifications with a real RIR hint get the canonical RIR host as first hop for implicit (no -h) batch and single queries; unknown/low-confidence, reserved/special and non-IP queries keep the legacy startup strategy. Explicit -h stays bypassed, stdout/stderr contract unchanged; P0/P1/Step47 matrix contracts unaffected because the flag is off in those suites.

D1.description: Forward-declare the Config-bound classifier-preferred first-hop helper in client_flow.c.

client_flow:
static const char* wc_client_preclass_first_hop_hint(const Config* config,
    const char* query);

idempotentContains:
static const char* wc_client_preclass_first_hop_hint(const Config* config,
    const char* query);

postApplyAssertions.name: first-hop-helper-declared
postApplyAssertions.pattern:
static const char\* wc_client_preclass_first_hop_hint\(const Config\* config,
    const char\* query\);

D2.description: Define the classifier-preferred first-hop helper: when preclass actions are enabled and preclass is not disabled, classify the query and return the canonical RIR host for allocated/legacy classifications with a real RIR hint; otherwise return NULL so callers keep the legacy startup strategy.

postApplyAssertions.name: first-hop-helper-defined

D3.description: Wire the classifier-preferred first hop into the batch start-host candidate collection: try the classifier hint first and keep the legacy guess as fallback.

client_flow:
wc_client_collect_batch_start_candidates(
        config, server_host, query, candidates, WC_BATCH_MAX_CANDIDATES);

operations.pattern:
size_t candidate_count = wc_client_collect_batch_start_candidates\(
        server_host, query, candidates, WC_BATCH_MAX_CANDIDATES\);
operations.replacement:
size_t candidate_count = wc_client_collect_batch_start_candidates(
        config, server_host, query, candidates, WC_BATCH_MAX_CANDIDATES);
idempotentContains:
wc_client_collect_batch_start_candidates(
        config, server_host, query, candidates, WC_BATCH_MAX_CANDIDATES);

D4.description: Wire the classifier-preferred first hop into the implicit single-query path, keeping the legacy guess as fallback.
